name: network.dns-proxy
title: Network:DNS Proxy
description: The declaration to configure DNS proxy settings.

payloadkeys.title: Visible name
payloadkeys.content: The name of the DNS proxy configuration that the system displays on the device.

payloadkeys.title: App bundle identifier
payloadkeys.content: The bundle identifier of the app containing the DNS proxy network extension.

payloadkeys.title: Provider composed identifier
payloadkeys.content:
The identifier of the provider to use for this configuration. Useful for apps that contain more than one DNS proxy extension.

In iOS and visionOS, the identifier is a bundle ID, for example, "com.example.app".

In macOS, the identifier is a composed identifier. The format of the composed identifier is either "Bundle-ID" or "Bundle-ID {Designated-Requirement}". "Bundle-ID" is the bundle identifier string of the provider. "Designated-Requirement" is the designated requirement string the device uses to match the code signature of the provider. For example, "com.example.app" for the bundle ID format, or "com.example.app {anchor apple generic}" for the designated requirement format.

payloadkeys.title: Provider configuration
payloadkeys.content: The dictionary of vendor-specific configuration items.

payloadkeys.title: DNS proxy UUID
payloadkeys.content: A globally unique identifier for this DNS proxy configuration. The proxy processes DNS lookups traffic for managed apps with the same `DNSProxyUUID` in their app attributes. This key is required for user enrollment.
